projects.use: Adapted code: www/app.js fmtDur → satisfactory_webui/web/app.js fmtDuration (unknown-value guard added). Inspiration only: metric cards, separate system/history panels and count-activity heatmap. New Linux sampling, SVG charts and UTC observed-count aggregation are original; no PowerShell, player log inference or automatic policies imported.
